plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero for capital preservation.
Sell SMH, METU, MUU, and PLTU as they are below their stops.
This plan prioritizes de-risking and reducing exposure to volatile assets.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% per month. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and positions below their stops. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest potential returns.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet the concentration mandate.
Sell SMH due to being below its stop.
Trim other high-risk or below-stop positions (SOXL, METU, MUU, PLTU, SPAL) to reduce overall risk.
Buy ERY, a strong scanner long setup, to add quality exposure.
This plan balances risk reduction with targeted growth opportunities.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for risk-first growth, targeting ~2.5% per month. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality scanner setup. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a focus on sustainable growth.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet the concentration mandate.
Sell SMH as it is below its stop.
Add to existing leveraged ETFs (SOXL, METU, MUU, PLTU, SPAL) to increase exposure.
Buy ERY, a strong scanner long setup, to further lean into growth.
This plan aggressively uses leverage and concentration for higher potential returns.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for stretch growth, targeting ~4% per month. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this strategy carries substantially higher risk, including larger potential drawdowns and daily decay of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Add to QQQI to increase income exposure and meet the mandate.
Sell SMH, SOXL, METU, MUU, PLTU, and SPAL.
These positions are either below stops, leveraged, or high-beta, not aligning with income goals.
This plan prioritizes steady distributions and low drawdown over growth.
income.read: This income plan aims to park cash for yield, targeting ~1% per month. It focuses on income-generating ETFs and broad index exposure, while cutting high-beta and leveraged positions. While prioritizing low drawdown and reliable income, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
